name: codecausality
description: Understand your repository and see what a code change can affect before you ship it.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: CodeCausality reads workspace source files and local Git history to build repository change-impact intelligence.

walkthroughs.title: Understand Change Before You Ship
walkthroughs.description: Use CodeCausality to inspect repository relationships and understand the likely impact of a code change.

steps.title: Open a repository
steps.description: Open a JavaScript or TypeScript Git repository. CodeCausality analyzes source relationships locally inside your workspace.

steps.title: Inspect one file
steps.description: Open a source file, then run [CodeCausality: Analyze Current File](command:codecausality.analyzeCurrentFile) to see downstream impact.

steps.title: Inspect your current changes
steps.description: Run [CodeCausality: Analyze Working Tree](command:codecausality.analyzeWorkingTree) to see the combined blast radius of your Git changes.

steps.title: Follow the evidence
steps.description: Use the impact graph, affected files, recommended tests, architecture guardrails, ownership, and history signals to understand the change before you ship it.
